strategy.primary: Tap/untap creature control: make targets with goad, forced attacks and tap effects, then use Tetsuo's {U}{B}{B}{R}, {T} to destroy tapped or blocking creatures, untapping him again and again (Minamo, Magewright's Stone, Thousand-Year Elixir, Alchemist, Fatestitcher, Puppeteer, Patriar's Seal, Retreat, Sting).
strategy.secondary: Turn the tapped board into cards and pressure with Verity Circle, Borrowing 100,000 Arrows, Firkraag, Karazikar and Grenzo; Rings of Brighthearth and Illusionist's Bracers copy activations.
